summary: Render the declared fluid scan axes using explicit SI or method-2 normalization, without kinetic globals or invented zero-field beta.

identity.relation: Bounded fluid scan to native plot artifacts
identity.definition: Method2 plots k*length_scale and omega/frequency_scale; omitted scales retain SI. Method3 uses theta in radians; method4 transposes canonical (kx,kz,root) state into the source surface orientation.
identity.model: Visualization of full local fluid spectra.
identity.coordinates: SI k and omega by default; only method2 admits paired normalization scales.
identity.boundary: No additional solve or branch matching.
assumptions: Undefined B=0 beta remains absent in annotations, never an invented zero.

Fluid constants profile: c2=(2.9979e8 m/s)^2, epsilon0=8.854e-12 F/m, mu0=1/(c2*epsilon0), gamma default5/3. Charge and mass are explicit SI deck inputs; packaged defaults use q=+/-1.602e-19 C, me=9.109e-31 kg and mp=1.673e-27 kg. Sound speeds are direct inputs; no kB or temperature-to-speed conversion is performed. This is distinct from current kinetic initialization epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m.

inputs.name: graph
inputs.units: k m^-1; omega rad/s; theta rad
inputs.constraints: Axes must match the declared method.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Explicit equilibrium mapping; no global state is read. Fluid fields are produced by fluid_equilibrium_si or fluid_equilibrium_relative_rates.
inputs.constraints: Required fluid fields q,m,n,v,csz2,csp2,epsnx,epsny,rho,B0,gamma,c2,epsilon0,mu0,Pz,Pp,Delta,pressure_frame,velocity_collision; retain nullable beta fields for rendering.

inputs.name: length_scale_m
inputs.constraints: Finite positive and supplied together with frequency_scale_rad_s; otherwise both omitted.

inputs.name: frequency_scale_rad_s
inputs.constraints: Finite positive; normalization for other methods is rejected.

inputs.name: capture_png
inputs.description: Return a PNG byte vector as well as plot-object counts.
inputs.constraints: False leaves the renderer PNG capture disabled.

inputs.name: transport
inputs.description: Optional explicit native executor; None uses the packaged resource closure.
inputs.constraints: Requires a compatible external Octave runtime. No original checkout or network is consulted.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: NativeResult state has plot_line_count,plot_surface_count and png_bytes; receipt is separate execution metadata.
outputs.shape: counts native scalar arrays; png_bytes vector
outputs.constraints: This renderer returns PNG and object counts, not a reusable native FIG.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Source methods1..4, with explicit canonical-axis to native mapping.
Paired positive normalization for method2 only.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

python.signature: fluid_plot_scan(graph, state, *, method=2, length_scale_m=None, frequency_scale_rad_s=None, capture_png=True, transport=None)

example.description: Requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64 for the native Octave path; this macOS execution is NOT_RUN.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.multifluid import fluid_equilibrium_si, scan_fluid_corrected
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.plotting import fluid_plot_scan
s = fluid_equilibrium_si()
g = scan_fluid_corrected(dict(state=s, grid_controls=dict(scan_k=[1e-5, 2e-5])))
r = fluid_plot_scan(g, s)
assert r.state["png_bytes"].size > 0
